scope: Public ALLLANG original MPR/Fsys asynchronous still-write contract; static evidence, not capture

request.address_selection: First descriptor virtual address nonzero: all descriptors use virtual addresses, mode 1; otherwise all use physical addresses, mode 2
request.file_content: Concatenate submitted spans in descriptor order, then truncate to u32 fileSize; descriptors have no file offset member
request.observer_policy: Hash only file-contributing prefixes in virtual mode; physical mode unsupported; checked arithmetic, complete reads, 32 requests and 128 MiB per request; original execution unchanged

internal_iovec.size_offset: 0x448 u64 sum of submitted descriptor lengths
internal_iovec.address_selection: descriptor[0].virtual_address != 0 selects all virtual addresses; otherwise all physical addresses
internal_iovec.virtual_validation: selected addresses nonzero and 4096 aligned; each submitted length 4096 aligned
internal_iovec.physical_validation: lower drive physical-write capability required; virtual pointer checks do not establish physical contents
internal_iovec.mapping: stream mapper exposes synthetic concatenated source range; queue preserves descriptor order and splits sequential writes

mpr_builder.file_size: u32 sum of original source lengths, independent from submitted rounded lengths
mpr_builder.capacity_guard: No eight-entry guard in examined MPR construction loop; observer records count>8 as unsupported without changing original execution

writer.semantics: Reject zero fileSize or fileSize>sum(iovec lengths); write sequential vectors, append filesystem padding if needed, then ftruncate(fileSize)
writer.open_flags: MPR sets 0x206; create/write behavior includes existing-file fallback and later truncate; bit 0x200 is opaque and not reserved-zero

completion.callback_abi: void callback(void *cookie, int status, const FSYSWRITEDIRECTFILERES *result)
completion.callback_status: Synchronous worker error takes precedence; otherwise original I/O queue status
completion.free_bytes: u64(u32(bytePerSector * sectorPerCluster)) * freeCluster; not encoded length
completion.lifetime: Copy callback result before forwarding. Copy work-item fields before forwarding; original _write_finished frees cookie. Callback return and worker return do not prove media contents.

flush.proof_policy: Preserve original flush result. Require callback-return, MPR worker-return and complete native readback for every token in the stopped-run log; new or missed requests invalidate proof. This observer is not a mutation admission lock.
